intro: Marisa du'Paige is a rare human rogue spellcaster found lurking within the sprawling cave network outside the entrance to the Deadmines in southwestern Westfall. Aligned with the outlaws operating beneath Moonbrook, she wields arcane magic alongside the laborers and highwaymen guarding the tunnels.

p: Deep inside the winding caverns that lead toward the Deadmines beneath Moonbrook, most defenders are rough-hewn cutpurses, renegade miners, and thugs. Marisa du'Paige stands out among them as a skilled human mage. While most spellcasters of the kingdom train within the sanctioned halls of Stormwind's Mage Quarter or serve the Kirin Tor, du'Paige has cast her lot with the outlaws and brigands hiding in Westfall's subterranean depths.
